title: UK Find a Tender — Public Contract Notices (OCDS API)
description: Search UK public-sector tenders and contract awards from the official Find a Tender OCDS API. Filter by CPV code, contract value, free text and open-deadline-only. Flat JSON rows with buyer email, phone and address, contract value, CPV codes, lot titles and deadlines.
seoTitle: UK Find a Tender Scraper — Government Contracts JSON API
seoDescription: Scrape UK government tenders and contract awards from the official Find a Tender OCDS API. Filter by CPV, value, keyword and open deadline. Buyer contact details included.

result.eventDescription: One normalized UK procurement notice returned to the dataset.
